title: Reports of aircraft that went missing after chasing objects

tellings.quote: there's there's a gentleman that sends me on several times a month stories that he's pulled up about aircraft that have mysteriously gone missing.

plain: A former Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says a man sends him stories several times a month about aircraft that vanished mysteriously. In these stories the planes went missing after chasing unknown objects, which, if true, would mean such encounters can be deadly.
